_comment: EMI coverage audit (tools/analysis/emi-coverage.mjs, lib/emi_coverage.mjs). Every item, block item, fluid and machine the pack registers needs an EMI-visible acquisition and, unless it is an end product, an EMI-visible use.
invisibleTypes: GT recipe types EMI never shows (GTM 7.5.3: the electric furnace's category is not registered, the dummy type is not XEI-visible).
endProducts: what needs no use (machines always; tools and final rewards here, each with its reason).
requirePages: an item made by a recipe of an invisible type, or whose only use is a place in a structure, also needs an info page (kubejs/assets/emi/recipe/additions/grindless/).

derived: routes the static stand-in cannot see, because a script derives them from the mods' own recipes or GTM generates them from a material's flags. Each one is checked against a native dump with --dump (category = EMI category).
exceptions: an item that genuinely has no acquisition or no use, with the reason. Keep it empty unless the design says so.

pendingRoutes: temporary, while an era is built. A recipe of ours EMI drops only because a stack of ours is disabled until its era (an input another package of the era makes). Each entry names the package that deletes it; an entry EMI no longer drops is a problem.
